title: 《穗守》白模占位资产清单 · White-box placeholder manifest
style: 中国田园水墨素模：无贴图、平面着色、低多边形；青瓦白墙/梯田/稻穗/竹篱意象；配色只用米白、墨灰、暖土、淡青与少量朱砂。
orientationRule: Three.js 中 +Z 为模型正面，对应 Blender 的 -Y；导出设置 +Y up，游戏原点在模型底部几何中心。

items.name: 青瓦白墙民居
items.gameRole: 农舍地标 / 出生点背景建筑
items.description: 单层三开间正房带一侧厢房，白灰墙、墨灰瓦、木格窗，前有小院矮墙与柴门。屋顶为双坡青瓦，檐口微微上翘；屋后有一截烟囱和一捆柴。
items.descriptionEn: A single-storey three-bay farmhouse with one side wing: whitewashed walls, dark grey tiled double-pitch roof with slightly upturned eaves, timber lattice windows, a low courtyard wall and a bamboo gate, a chimney and a small firewood stack.
items.proportions: 正房约 5.0 m 宽、檐口高约 2.5 m、屋脊高约 3.6 m；厢房高约为正房的 70%，总高约 4.0 m。
items.notes: replace with env_house.glb; placed at WORLD.decorations.farmhouse

items.descriptionEn: A bamboo-and-timber waterwheel on a stone channel, eight spokes, two bamboo rims, with a small thatched shelter and a flume. The wheel must be a separate child object so the game can rotate it.
items.proportions: 水轮直径约 2.4 m，中心离地约 1.45 m；棚顶高约 3.6 m。

items.descriptionEn: A bamboo gate with two thick posts and a lintel, five hanging cloth strips alternating rice-white and vermilion, and a dark mountain opening behind. The cloth strips should be a separate child object for gentle sway.
items.proportions: 门柱高 2.7 m，门宽 1.9 m，横梁离地 2.62 m。

items.gameRole: 守望之种 / 核心目标祭坛
items.description: 三层圆形石台，四根石柱各立一束稻穗，中央悬浮由七束稻穗围成的金色谷灵，外有两道细光环。谷灵与光环需可独立旋转。
items.descriptionEn: A three-tier round stone altar with four stone posts, each holding a rice sheaf; at the centre floats a golden grain spirit ringed by seven rice stalks and two thin halos. The grain spirit and halos must be separate rotating children.
items.proportions: 底层直径 4.6 m，台高 0.6 m，谷灵中心离地约 1.5 m。
items.notes: 子对象 Crystal / Halo 用于旋转

items.name: 梯田段
items.gameRole: 东侧三级水田（菜单/俯瞰可见的场景地标）
items.description: 三级阶梯水田：每级有夯土挡墙、石砌田唇、浅水与成排秧苗，最高一级最窄，形成向内收的梯田轮廓。
items.descriptionEn: A three-tier paddy terrace: each tier has a packed-earth retaining wall, a stone lip, shallow water and rows of seedlings; the highest tier is the narrowest, giving the stepped inward silhouette of a terraced field.
items.proportions: 三级台地每级高差 0.78 m，台面进深约 2.07 m；前层最宽 12 m，向上每层收窄约 2.2 m。

items.proportions: 冠幅 0.9 m，最高稻穗 1.3 m；稻穗约占顶部 1/3 高度。

items.description: 一条主藤、五片掌状叶，两只大小不一的瓜，瓜面有浅棱，旁边一朵小黄花。
items.descriptionEn: A main vine with five palmate leaves, two gourds of different sizes with shallow ribs, and a small yellow flower.
items.proportions: 两只瓜直径 0.54 m / 0.42 m，藤蔓高 0.72 m；整体不高于 1.1 m。

items.description: 一根细茎、四片窄叶、七片米白花瓣，中心是一颗浅金发光花蕊，花下有一圈很淡的光环。
items.descriptionEn: A slender stem with four narrow leaves, seven rice-white petals, a pale-gold glowing centre and a faint halo below the bloom.
items.proportions: 花朵直径 0.55 m，花心离地约 0.95 m，光环直径 0.5 m。
items.notes: 发光花蕊请用独立材质槽 Emissive，方便游戏替换

items.proportions: 身高 1.75 m，竹耙高 0.95 m，秧篮直径 0.35 m。

items.description: 背药篓、挎葫芦的山民，药篓里插五束草药，一手捏一株草药。
items.descriptionEn: A mountain herbalist with a herb basket on the back and a gourd at the waist; five herb bundles stick out of the basket and one herb is held in a hand.
items.proportions: 身高 1.8 m，药篓高 0.5 m，葫芦高 0.25 m；纵深含药篓约 1.0 m。

items.description: 系皮围裙的石匠，右手提木锤、左手握凿子，脚边一块待凿的石料。
items.descriptionEn: A stone mason in a leather apron, holding a wooden mallet in the right hand and a chisel in the left, with a block of stone at his feet.
items.proportions: 身高 1.85 m，木锤长 0.5 m，脚边石料 0.24 m 见方。

items.gameRole: 乡勇 ricespirit 的基础白模；等级缩放 + 等级珠
items.description: 没有脚的稻穗精灵：米白长袍下摆散成草叶，头顶一圈七束小稻穗，身周一道细光环。光环需可独立旋转。
items.descriptionEn: A footless rice spirit: rice-white robe that frays into grass blades at the hem, a crown of seven small rice ears, and a thin halo around the body. The halo must be a separate child for rotation.
items.proportions: 身高 1.8 m（含冠），光环直径 0.92 m，袍摆直径 0.7 m。
items.notes: 子对象命名 Halo 用于旋转

items.descriptionEn: A light-built fox with pointed ears, long muzzle, a big bushy tail, slender legs and two vermilion eyes.
items.proportions: 肩高 0.55 m，体长 1.2 m，尾长 0.65 m；整体高不超过 0.9 m。

items.description: 高大的白鹿王：分叉鹿角、修长四肢、高抬头颈，通体米白，眼睛浅金；脚下有游戏叠加的光环。
items.descriptionEn: A tall white stag king with branching antlers, long legs, a raised head and neck, rice-white body and pale-gold eyes; the game adds a boss aura at its feet.
items.proportions: 肩高 1.5 m，鹿角尖高 2.4 m，体长 2.0 m。

items.name: 守望者（第三人称）
items.gameRole: 俯瞰视角下可见的玩家角色
items.description: 戴斗笠、穿米白短衫与墨灰裤的年轻守望者，背后可加一顶小斗篷；模型需分出头、躯干、双臂、双腿四组，以便走路摆动。
items.descriptionEn: A young farmer in a straw hat, rice-white jacket and ink-grey trousers, with an optional short cape; head, torso, two arms and two legs must be separate groups for walking animation.
items.proportions: 身高 1.9 m（含斗笠），肩宽 0.54 m，头身比约 1:6。

items.proportions: 柄长 0.92 m，刃宽 0.26 m；握把位于柄的 1/3 处。
